about: Enjoy 6 hours of new gameplay in Valley of Memory, a free major update that expands Basim’s story and introduces the breathtaking new region of AlUla, with gameplay improvements across the full game.
Become the most versatile and resourceful Assassin in franchise history. Parkour seamlessly through the city and leverage the largest assortment of tools to date.
Get contracts and upgrades at the Assassin’s bureaus, collect vital clues, and stealthily take down targets with more visceral assassinations than ever before.
summary: Live the Powerful Coming-of-Age Story of a Thief Turned Master Assassin
